class_note: Identified cell (LG INR18650HG2, Kollmeyer dataset fit); pack assembly (interconnects, wrap, leads) and box are estimates. Each parallel group is one equivalent cell.

rated_capacity_ah.source: 2 x template reference capacity 2.78074 Ah (Kollmeyer et al. LG 18650HG2 dataset (Mendeley Data doi:10.17632/b5mj79w5w9.2, CC BY 4.0), C/20 to 2.8 V at 25 °C); LG nominal 3.0 Ah per cell to 2.0 V

resistance_scale.source: real cell: template resistances apply unscaled; the capacity normalisation reference/rated = 1/parallel gives the parallel-group resistance

interconnect_resistance_ohm.source: 3 series nickel-strip joints (0.15 x 8 mm, 20 mm, about 1.2 mOhm each) / 2 parallel strip(s) plus 2 mOhm leads and XT60-class connector

mass_kg.source: 8 x 48.0 g cell (LG Chem product specification INR18650HG2 (PS-HG2-Rev5, 2017-03-31): weight max 48.0 g; a retailer weighed 44.86 g) + 8 x 6 g strip/insulation/wrap + 15 g leads, connector and balance lead (allowances estimated)

dimensions_m.source: 4 cells side by side x 2 layer(s), cell 18.5 mm x 65.2 mm max (LG Chem product specification INR18650HG2 (PS-HG2-Rev5, 2017-03-31)) plus 2.5–3 mm wrap

still_air_w_per_k.source: h_nat·A with h_nat = 5 W/(m²·K) (Incropera & DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, Table 1.1: free convection of gases 2–25 W/(m²·K)) and A = 0.021974 m² from the estimated box

forced_w_per_k_per_sqrt_mps.source: A·0.664·k·Pr^(1/3)/sqrt(ν·L): laminar flat-plate average Nusselt number Nu_L = 0.664·Re_L^0.5·Pr^(1/3) (Incropera & DeWitt eq. 7.30) with air at 300 K k = 0.0263 W/(m·K), ν = 15.89e-6 m²/s, Pr = 0.707 (Table A.4), L = pack length 0.0770 m; installation airflow not included

label.source: LG Chem product specification INR18650HG2 (PS-HG2-Rev5, 2017-03-31): max. continuous discharge 20 A per cell / 3.0 Ah nominal; informative only
